reviews.t: This shower cap gave me my life confidence back
reviews.x: Cap changed my life. Never again will I be soiled with wet hair like a common dog in the rain. This bad boy will keep all your hairs dry while also keeping you fashion forward. All the nana's will be talking about you down the block, how jealous they are of your supreme shower cap. Highly recommended
I was pleasantly surprised to find this was a 3-pack deal.  One of the nicest shower caps I've owned.  The band is a little tight but I'm sure will loosen after a few uses.
Made for small heads. Like the quality and feel but, isn't big enough even for med length hair.

I like the large size of this cap and I able to keep my thick waist length hair tucked inside it firmly . Good quality and soft too. No scratchiness or band impressions on the forehead. Bought two of the caps- one for me and another for my daughter who has longer hair than me. Beautiful designs printed in the cap.

Ironically, these shower caps are very tight, and therefore very small.  With that said though, they are very good because they keep the water out.  It takes a bit to get used to getting them on properly, but once you master that, your hair will not fall out and so your hair stays dry.

Pretty good. One out of the three elastic band snapped in first use. Rendering it useless. The other two are tight, but not too tight. I have hair down to my lower back and it has plenty of room for all my hair. Gets the job done and keeps my hair dry.

These shows caps are not only fashionable but very functional. There are three different caps in a package and they actually fit all of my long, thick hair inside of them! Use a scrunchy to put your hair into a bun and put the cap over all of that. They work wonderfully. Thanks Joemoon! I will buy more when these caps are worn out!

reviews.t: Long hair? Nope. Same as any other cap.
reviews.x: I ordered this one specifically because it said it was for long hair. It's the exact same size as the one I currently have and hate. My hair is down to my bum and not going to fit in this cap either.
I love these shower caps they are awesome made very well!!
Looks but after a month or so it start to small like mildew and there is no why to get the smell away not even machine washing it, it does not dry well.
This is no way a large shower cap . I don't have a big head and it was even too tight. total waste of money
The caps were advertised as large. They were small and consequently uncomfortable as the result.
Elastic is breaking inside cap, thrown one away already

I gave this an overall 3 stars for one reason only.  I have only been using this for a month or so and I noticed the seam that holds the elastic has ripped open exposing the rubber band so with that I am disappointed and hopefully it won’t rip any more.  I do love how pretty it is and how much room there is in the cap because I use those butterfly clips to hold up my hair.  It does keep my hair dry but does need some maintenance after taking the cap off for slight humidity I feel gets in.  Would

After waiting weeks for the 3 shower caps  for long hair to be delivered , I opened the sealed package and there were 2 caps . The pretty  pink one was missing .The. Black floral and animal print were enclosed .  Not very cheerful on one’s head plus the band is too tight and not for long hair . I really do not have a big head .  Very disappointed . Do not recommend buying .

We didn't have any issues in the specific categories listed above. However, overall I’m a bit disappointed in the quality of this cap. My 6-year-old has used the cap daily since mid-March, and the elastic band broke last week, making the product unusable. Her head is small, and she didn’t do anything extreme to the cap. Seems that this should last more than three months.

These caps are really small. I'm not sure how anyone is fitting waist length hair into them. I specifically searched for large to extra large shower cap. These are not either. They're a perfect size for a young person or someone with short hair and a small head. I'll keep them and give them to friends with kids. They are super cute visually.

I just came back to edit my previous review.  I have used on cap for a month and the elastic already broke.  I probably used the cap a couple of times a week, so not that many times and it is already broken.  The plastic is rough around the edges which irritates your face.  It is a cheap product from China.  I would not purchase again.

These are really pretty and well made.  The only problem I have is they are a little tight.  Someone with a larger head or a lot of hair might find it too tight....maybe.  I have one in our guest bathroom as well as our own and one in my luggage. For the money you'd be hard pressed to find a prettier, well made cap.

I only gave these caps two stars because they are pretty.  They are very small.  The elastic is so tight and for some reason the way the caps are constructed they won't stay up on the front/top of my head.  They slip down to the top of my eyes.  They are unusable.  Very disappointed.  Will have to donate them.

reviews.t: Joemoon Premium Shower Cap Women Long Hair Fabric Eco Waterproof Lined Washable 3 Pack
reviews.x: MY wife loves these new shower caps for her long hair. Silky and stylish adds to the elastic styled cap to hold her beautiful long hair in while showering. Three in a pack and a great deal. Fast delivery. She recommends this product. so ladies, try them you also will be amazed.

My daughter and I have long thick hair and this worked perfectly. All my hair fit and did not get wet. Perfect if you don't like to wash your hair every day. The colors are interesting but that does  not matter to me. I only wanted it to cover my hair. Elastic works.

Its a shower cap but has multiple uses. There's 3 in a package  I use one for showering..another one for conditioning my hair..and  an extra one..just in case.  The material is awesome . Soft..dont make u sweat. But protects you trom from your hair getting wet

The large size is perfect because I wear rollers under them while I shower and get ready. First one I wore the elastic broke within a week but so far the 2nd one is holding up. I still have a third one that o will wear when the one I’m using now finally does.

reviews.t: Great cap! Can’t beat the price.
reviews.x: These fit a little snug but that’s the goal! Honey i know i look like Mrs.Roper in it ( its what my husband said, 😂) but let me tell you, not a drop of water gets in and my hair is as dry just as i intented it to be when i put this beautiful cap on!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the caps too tight or too small, especially for large heads or long hair.
Several reviewers praise the quality, softness, and roominess for holding long or thick hair.
Some reviewers report durability problems like snapping or exposed elastic.
A few reviewers mention the caps keep hair dry and get the job done.
Some reviewers note issues with mildew smell, drying, or missing caps from the pack.
